pages.title: North American Beaver
pages.text: The North American beaver ($(o)Castor canadensis$()) is a large rodent of rivers, streams and lakes across North America.$(br2)It fells trees with its teeth and builds dams of sticks and mud that create ponds, changing whole landscapes.$(br2)When alarmed, a beaver slaps its broad, flat tail on the water to warn others before diving.
